Petunjuk pola kode

  • Query: kondisi/relasi membentuk SQL. Scope awal dan preload memengaruhi akses serta jumlah query.
  • Rescue: menangani exception yang disebut; lihat apakah hasil menjadi pesan, rollback atau retry.

1module Paginatable2  DEFAULT_PER_PAGE = 2534  private56  def paginate(scope, per_page: DEFAULT_PER_PAGE, total_count: nil)7    table_key = scope.klass.table_name8    controls = table_requested_controls(table_key)9    scope, filters = table_filter_scope(scope, controls)10    count = total_count.nil? || controls.present? ? scope.except(:select, :order).count : total_count11    @total_count = count.is_a?(Hash) ? count.size : count12    selected = controls[:per_page].presence || params[:per_page].presence13    @per_page = selected == "all" ? [@total_count, 1].max : ([10, 25, 50, 100].include?(selected.to_i) ? selected.to_i : per_page)14    @total_pages = [ (@total_count.to_f / @per_page).ceil, 1 ].max15    @page = (controls[:page].presence || params[:page]).to_i.clamp(1, @total_pages)16    @table_controls ||= {}17    @table_controls[table_key] = { key: table_key, filters: filters, date_column: table_date_column(scope.klass), count: @total_count, page: @page, pages: @total_pages, per_page: selected == "all" ? "all" : @per_page }1819    scope.limit(@per_page).offset((@page - 1) * @per_page)20  end2122  def table_requested_controls(key)23    tables = params[:tables]24    return {} unless tables.respond_to?(:key?) && tables.respond_to?(:fetch)25    controls = tables.fetch(key, {})26    controls.respond_to?(:key?) && controls.respond_to?(:fetch) ? controls : {}27  end2829  def table_filter_scope(scope, controls)30    model = scope.klass31    query = controls[:q].to_s.strip.first(200)32    if query.present?33      predicate = table_search_predicate(model, "%#{ActiveRecord::Base.sanitize_sql_like(query)}%")34      scope = scope.where(predicate) if predicate35    end36    filters = []37    %w[status role active is_popular rating payment_method provider gateway_environment category_id city_id business_id staff_id].each do |field|38      next unless model.column_names.include?(field)39      options = table_filter_options(scope, field)40      next if options.empty?41      filters << { field: field, options: options }42      selected = controls[field].to_s43      scope = scope.where(model.arel_table[field].eq(selected)) if options.any? { |(_, value)| value.to_s == selected } && selected.present?44    end45    if model == Booking46      %w[service_id staff_id].each do |field|47        items = BookingItem.where(booking_id: scope.except(:select, :order, :group).select(:id))48        related = field == "service_id" ? Service : Staff49        options = related.where(id: items.select(field)).order(:name).pluck(:name, :id)50        filters << { field: field, options: options } if options.any?51        selected = controls[field].to_s52        if selected.present? && options.any? { |(_, value)| value.to_s == selected }53          scope = scope.where(id: items.where(field => selected).select(:booking_id))54        end55      end56    elsif model == Business57      categories = Category.joins(:business_categories).where(business_categories: { business_id: scope.except(:select, :order).select(:id) }).distinct.order(:name).pluck(:name, :id)58      filters << { field: "category_id", options: categories } if categories.any?59      selected = controls[:category_id].to_s60      if selected.present? && categories.any? { |(_, value)| value.to_s == selected }61        scope = scope.where(id: BusinessCategory.where(category_id: selected).select(:business_id))62      end63    end64    if (column = table_date_column(model))65      { from: :gteq, to: :lteq }.each do |boundary, operator|66        value = controls[boundary].to_s67        next if value.blank?68        begin69          date = Date.iso8601(value)70          timestamp = boundary == :from ? date.in_time_zone.beginning_of_day : date.in_time_zone.end_of_day71          scope = scope.where(model.arel_table[column].public_send(operator, timestamp))72        rescue Date::Error, ArgumentError73          # Ignore malformed dates; keep the list available.74        end75      end76    end77    [scope, filters]78  end7980  def table_search_predicate(model, term, depth = 0, visited = [])81    predicates = %w[name title email phone reference booking_reference order_id transaction_id code address description reason content].filter_map do |column|82      model.arel_table[column].matches(term) if model.column_names.include?(column)83    end84    if depth < 285      model.reflect_on_all_associations(:belongs_to).each do |association|86        next if association.polymorphic? || visited.include?(association.klass)87        related = association.klass88        predicate = table_search_predicate(related, term, depth + 1, visited + [model])89        next unless predicate90        predicates << model.arel_table[association.foreign_key].in(related.where(predicate).select(related.primary_key).arel)91      end92    end93    predicates.reduce { |left, right| left.or(right) }94  end9596  def table_date_column(model)97    %w[start_time starts_at created_at].find { |column| model.column_names.include?(column) }98  end99100  def table_filter_options(scope, field)101    model = scope.klass102    if model.defined_enums.key?(field)103      return model.defined_enums.fetch(field).keys.map { |value| [table_option_label(model, field, value), value] }104    end105    if model.type_for_attribute(field).type == :boolean106      return [[I18n.t("table_controls.yes"), "true"], [I18n.t("table_controls.no"), "false"]]107    end108    association = model.reflect_on_all_associations(:belongs_to).find { |item| !item.polymorphic? && item.foreign_key == field }109    values = scope.except(:select, :group, :order, :limit, :offset).distinct.pluck(field).compact110    if association111      return association.klass.where(id: values).order(:name).pluck(:name, :id) if association.klass.column_names.include?("name")112    end113    values.sort_by(&:to_s).map { |value| [table_option_label(model, field, value), value] }114  end115116  def table_option_label(model, field, value)117    key = case field118    when "role" then "admin.users.roles.#{value}"119    when "status" then model == Business ? "admin.businesses.#{value}" : (model == Booking ? "booking.status.#{value}" : "booking.payment_statuses.#{value}")120    else "table_controls.values.#{value}"121    end122    I18n.t(key, default: value.to_s.humanize)123  end124end

All times are computed in the app timezone (Asia/Jakarta).45class Availability6  SLOT_GRANULARITY = 30.minutes78  attr_reader :date, :staff_ids, :duration_minutes910  def initialize(business:, service:, date:, staff: nil, duration_minutes: nil, excluding_booking: nil)11    @business = business12    @service = service13    @date = date14    @staff = staff15    @duration_minutes = duration_minutes || service.duration_minutes16    @excluding_booking = excluding_booking17    eligible_ids = eligible_staff_ids18    @staff_ids = staff ? eligible_ids & [staff.id] : eligible_ids19  end2021  # Returns array of { time:, staff_ids: } hashes for each bookable start time22  def slots23    @slots ||= compute_slots24  end2526  def available_at?(time)27    slots.any? { |s| s[:time] == time }28  end2930  def has_availability?31    slots.any?32  end3334  def staff_available_at?(time)35    slot = slots.find { |s| s[:time] == time }36    slot ? slot[:staff_ids] : []37  end3839  # Later services in one appointment may begin between the displayed slots.40  # They still need to fit completely inside the day's available intervals.41  def staff_available_during(time)42    return [] if time.nil? || time.to_date != date || time <= Time.current4344    window = business_window45    finish = time + duration_minutes.minutes46    return [] if window.nil? || time < window.first || finish > window.last4748    staff_ids.select { |sid| staff_free?(sid, time, finish) }49  end5051  private5253  def compute_slots54    return [] unless date >= Date.current5556    window = business_window57    return [] if window.nil?5859    candidates = []6061    slot_time = window.first62    last_start = window.last - duration_minutes.minutes63    while slot_time <= last_start64      available_staff = staff_available_during(slot_time)65      if available_staff.any?66        candidates << { time: slot_time, staff_ids: available_staff }67      end68      slot_time += SLOT_GRANULARITY69    end7071    candidates72  end7374  def business_window75    hour = business_hours.find_by(weekday: date.wday)76    return nil if hour.nil? || hour.closed?7778    base = day_base79    [base + hour.open_minute.minutes, base + hour.close_minute.minutes]80  end8182  def day_base83    @day_base ||= Time.zone.local(date.year, date.month, date.day)84  end8586  def business_hours87    @business.business_hours88  end8990  def eligible_staff_ids91    @business.staff.active.joins(:services).where(services: { id: @service.id }).distinct.ids92  end9394  def staff_free?(staff_id, start, finish)95    working_hours?(staff_id, start, finish) &&96      !on_break?(staff_id, start, finish) &&97      !blocked?(staff_id, start, finish) &&98      !booked?(staff_id, start, finish)99  end100101  def working_hours?(staff_id, start, finish)102    covered_until = minute_of_day(start)103    StaffSchedule.where(staff_id: staff_id, weekday: date.wday).order(:start_minute)104                 .pluck(:start_minute, :end_minute).each do |opens, closes|105      next if closes <= covered_until106      break if opens > covered_until107108      covered_until = closes109      return true if covered_until >= minute_of_day(finish)110    end111    false112  end113114  def on_break?(staff_id, start, finish)115    StaffBreak.where(staff_id: staff_id, weekday: date.wday)116              .where("start_minute < ? AND end_minute > ?", minute_of_day(finish), minute_of_day(start))117              .exists?118  end119120  def blocked?(staff_id, start, finish)121    BlockedTime.overlapping(start...finish)122               .for_staff(staff_id)123               .where(business_id: @business.id)124               .exists?125  end126127  def booked?(staff_id, start, finish)128    scope = BookingItem.active129               .joins(:booking)130               .where(staff_id: staff_id)131               .where(bookings: { business_id: @business.id, status: %w[pending confirmed] })132               .where("booking_items.during && tstzrange(?, ?, '[)')", start, finish)133    scope = scope.where.not(booking_id: @excluding_booking.id) if @excluding_booking134    scope.exists?135  end136137  def minute_of_day(time)138    ((time - day_base) / 60).to_i139  end140end

1class BookingBuilder2  # Checks availability before creating a booking in a DB transaction. The3  # tstzrange EXCLUDE constraint handles concurrent requests for the same staff.45  def initialize(user:, business:, service_ids:, staff_id: nil, start_time:, payment_method: nil)6    @user = user7    @business = business8    @service_ids = Array(service_ids).map(&:to_i).uniq9    @staff_id = staff_id10    @start_time = start_time11    @payment_method = payment_method.presence || "pay_at_venue"12  end1314  def call15    services = Service.active.where(id: @service_ids, business_id: @business.id).order(:id).to_a16    return BookingResult.new(error: I18n.t("alerts.booking_builder.service_not_found")) if services.empty? || services.size != @service_ids.count17    return BookingResult.new(error: I18n.t("alerts.booking_builder.time_unavailable")) unless @start_time.respond_to?(:to_date)1819    @staff_error = nil20    staff = resolve_staff(services)21    return BookingResult.new(error: @staff_error) if staff.nil? && @staff_error.present?22    return BookingResult.new(error: I18n.t("alerts.booking_builder.time_unavailable")) if staff.nil?2324    unless sequence_available?(services, staff)25      return BookingResult.new(error: I18n.t("alerts.booking_builder.time_unavailable"))26    end2728    end_time = @start_time + services.sum(&:duration_minutes).minutes2930    Booking.transaction(requires_new: true) do31      booking = Booking.create!(32        user: @user,33        business: @business,34        start_time: @start_time,35        end_time: end_time,36        total_amount: services.sum(&:price),37        payment_method: @payment_method,38        status: :confirmed39      )4041      cursor = @start_time42      services.each do |service|43        BookingItem.create!(44          booking: booking,45          service: service,46          staff: staff,47          price: service.price,48          duration_minutes: service.duration_minutes,49          during: cursor...(cursor + service.duration_minutes.minutes)50        )51        cursor += service.duration_minutes.minutes52      end5354      # Reload supaya asosiasi (booking_items) tidak stale di memori55      # — item dibuat SETELAH booking, dan validasi saat create bisa56      # memuat asosiasi kosong ke cache objek.57      BookingResult.new(booking: booking.reload)58    end59  rescue ActiveRecord::RecordInvalid => e60    BookingResult.new(error: e.record.errors.full_messages.to_sentence)61  rescue ActiveRecord::RecordNotUnique, ActiveRecord::ExclusionViolation => e62    if e.message.include?("no_overlapping_bookings")63      BookingResult.new(error: I18n.t("alerts.booking_builder.slot_taken"))64    else65      BookingResult.new(error: I18n.t("alerts.booking_builder.save_failed"))66    end67  end6869  private7071  # An explicitly chosen staff must offer every selected service; if the72  # choice is invalid we stop with an error instead of silently booking73  # another staff member. 1class BookingRescheduler2  class Unavailable < StandardError; end34  def initialize(booking:, start_time:)5    @booking = booking6    @start_time = start_time7  end89  def call10    @booking.with_lock(requires_new: true) do11      raise Unavailable unless @booking.reschedulable? && @start_time.respond_to?(:to_date)1213      availability = BookingSequenceAvailability.new(business: @booking.business,14        booking: @booking, date: @start_time.to_date)15      raise Unavailable unless availability.available_at?(@start_time)1617      items = @booking.booking_items.order(:during, :id).to_a18      # Release our old ranges within this transaction so moving earlier cannot19      # collide with another item belonging to this same appointment.20      @booking.booking_items.update_all(during: nil, updated_at: Time.current)21      cursor = @start_time22      items.each do |item|23        finish = cursor + item.duration_minutes.minutes24        item.update!(during: cursor...finish)25        cursor = finish26      end27      @booking.update!(start_time: @start_time, end_time: cursor)28    end29    BookingResult.new(booking: @booking.reload)30  rescue Unavailable, ActiveRecord::RecordInvalid31    BookingResult.new(error: I18n.t("alerts.booking.slot_taken"))32  rescue ActiveRecord::ExclusionViolation, ActiveRecord::RecordNotUnique33    BookingResult.new(error: I18n.t("alerts.booking.slot_taken"))34  end35end

1# Checks a complete appointment. New bookings use one qualified staff member2# for every service; rescheduling preserves each item's staff and sold duration.3class BookingSequenceAvailability4  def initialize(business:, date:, services: nil, staff: nil, booking: nil)5    @booking = booking6    @segments = if booking7      booking.booking_items.order(:during, :id).includes(:service, :staff).map do |item|8        [item.service, item.staff, item.duration_minutes]9      end10    else11      Array(services).map { |service| [service, staff, service.duration_minutes] }12    end13    @engines = @segments.map do |service, member, duration|14      Availability.new(business: business, service: service, date: date, staff: member,15                       duration_minutes: duration, excluding_booking: booking)16    end17  end1819  def slots20    @slots ||= begin21      if @engines.empty? || (@booking && @segments.any? { |_, member, _| member.nil? })22        []23      else24        @engines.first.slots.filter_map do |slot|25          members = sequence_staff_ids(slot[:time])26          { time: slot[:time], staff_ids: members } if members.any?27        end28      end29    end30  end3132  def available_at?(time)33    staff_available_at?(time).any?34  end3536  def staff_available_at?(time)37    slots.find { |slot| slot[:time] == time }&.fetch(:staff_ids) || []38  end3940  private4142  def sequence_staff_ids(time)43    common_staff = nil44    assigned_staff = []45    @engines.each_with_index do |engine, index|46      members = engine.staff_available_during(time)47      return [] if members.empty?4849      if @booking50        assigned_staff.concat(members)51      else52        common_staff = common_staff ? common_staff & members : members53        return [] if common_staff.empty?54      end55      time += @segments[index].last.minutes56    end57    @booking ? assigned_staff.uniq : common_staff58  end59end

valid_checkout_url?(url)63    return false unless url.is_a?(String)6465    uri = URI.parse(url)66    uri.scheme == "https" && uri.host == @endpoints.fetch(:checkout_host) && uri.port == 443 && uri.userinfo.nil?67  rescue URI::InvalidURIError68    false69  end7071  def transaction_status(order_id)72    request(@endpoints.fetch(:status), { merchantCode: merchant_code, merchantOrderId: order_id,73      signature: signature(merchant_code + order_id) })74  end7576  def valid_signature?(payload)77    expected = signature(payload.fetch("merchantCode").to_s + payload.fetch("amount").to_s + payload.fetch("merchantOrderId").to_s)78    received = payload.fetch("signature").to_s79    received.bytesize == expected.bytesize && ActiveSupport::SecurityUtils.secure_compare(expected, received)80  end8182  private8384  def signature(value)85    OpenSSL::HMAC.hexdigest("SHA256", @api_key, value)86  end8788  def invoice_payload(attempt)89    booking = attempt.booking90    base = Rails.configuration.x.app_host.chomp("/")91    { paymentAmount: attempt.amount, merchantOrderId: attempt.order_id,92      productDetails: "GlowBook #{booking.reference}", customerVaName: booking.user.full_name.to_s.first(20),93      email: booking.user.email, phoneNumber: booking.user.phone.to_s,94      itemDetails: [{ name: "Booking #{booking.reference}", price: attempt.amount, quantity: 1 }],95      callbackUrl: "#{base}#{Rails.application.routes.url_helpers.duitku_callback_path}",96      returnUrl: "#{base}#{Rails.application.routes.url_helpers.booking_path(booking.reference)}", expiryPeriod: @expiry_minutes }97  end9899  def request(endpoint, body, headers = {})100    uri = URI(endpoint)101    request = Net::HTTP::Post.new(uri)102    request["Content-Type"] = "application/json"103    request["Accept"] = "application/json"104    headers.each { |name, value| request[name] = value }105    request.body = JSON.generate(body)106    response = Net::HTTP.start(uri.host, uri.port, use_ssl: true, open_timeout: 3, read_timeout: 5, write_timeout: 5) { |http| http.request(request) }107    raise AmbiguousError, I18n.t("duitku.gateway_unavailable") unless response.is_a?(Net::HTTPSuccess)108109    parsed = JSON.parse(response.body)110    raise AmbiguousError, I18n.t("duitku.gateway_unavailable") unless parsed.is_a?(Hash)111112    parsed113  rescue JSON::ParserError, Net::OpenTimeout, Net::ReadTimeout, Net::WriteTimeout, SocketError, IOError, SystemCallError, OpenSSL::SSL::SSLError114    raise AmbiguousError, I18n.t("duitku.gateway_unavailable")115  end116end

1# Initial production setup. Adds reference data and the first administrator;2# existing records and passwords are preserved when the task is repeated.3class PlatformBootstrap4  CITIES = %w[Jakarta Bandung Surabaya Bali Yogyakarta Medan].freeze5  CATEGORIES = [6    ["Rambut", "rambut", "scissors"], ["Facial", "facial", "sparkles"],7    ["Nail Art", "nail-art", "hand"], ["Massage", "massage", "lotus"],8    ["Hair Coloring", "hair-coloring", "palette"], ["Eyelash", "eyelash", "eye"],9    ["Spa", "spa", "flower"], ["Barber", "barber", "razor"],10    ["Makeup", "makeup", "brush"], ["Body Treatment", "body-treatment", "droplet"]11  ].freeze1213  def self.call(email:, password: nil, name: "Admin GlowBook")14    email = email.to_s.strip.downcase15    raise ArgumentError, "ADMIN_EMAIL is required" if email.blank?1617    ApplicationRecord.transaction do18      admin = User.find_or_initialize_by(email: email)19      if admin.persisted?20        raise ArgumentError, "The existing account is not an administrator" unless admin.admin?21      else22        raise ArgumentError, "ADMIN_PASSWORD must contain at least 12 characters" if password.to_s.length < 122324        admin.assign_attributes(name: name, role: :admin, password: password, password_confirmation: password)25        admin.save!26      end2728      CITIES.each { |city| City.find_or_create_by!(slug: city.parameterize) { |record| record.name = city } }29      CATEGORIES.each_with_index do |(label, slug, icon), index|30        Category.find_or_create_by!(slug: slug) do |record|31          record.assign_attributes(name: label, icon_name: icon, position: index, is_popular: index < 8)32        end33      end34      PlatformSetting.current35      admin36    end37  end38end

app/services/process_duitku_notification.rb

Verifikasi callback signature/merchant/amount/reference lalu delegasi rekonsiliasi status server.

Method yang dideklarasikan: initialize, call, verify_amount!

Petunjuk pola kode
  • Transaction/lock: menjaga kesatuan perubahan dan mengatur request bersamaan; tidak menggantikan constraint DB.
  • Rescue: menangani exception yang disebut; lihat apakah hasil menjadi pesan, rollback atau retry.
Buka 32 baris kode
1require "bigdecimal"23class ProcessDuitkuNotification4  class InvalidNotification < StandardError; end56  def initialize(payload:, client: DuitkuClient.new(allow_disabled: true))7    @payload = payload.stringify_keys8    @client = client9  end1011  def call12    raise InvalidNotification unless @payload.fetch("merchantCode") == @client.merchant_code && @client.valid_signature?(@payload)1314    attempt = PaymentAttempt.find_by!(provider: "duitku", order_id: @payload.fetch("merchantOrderId"),15      merchant_code: @client.merchant_code, gateway_environment: @client.environment)16    verify_amount!(attempt, @payload.fetch("amount"))17    reference = @payload.fetch("reference")18    raise InvalidNotification unless reference.is_a?(String) && reference.present?19    raise InvalidNotification if attempt.transaction_id.present? && attempt.transaction_id != reference2021    ReconcileDuitkuPayment.new(attempt: attempt, client: @client).call(expected_reference: reference)22  rescue KeyError, ArgumentError, ActiveRecord::RecordNotFound, ReconcileDuitkuPayment::InvalidStatus23    raise InvalidNotification24  end2526  private2728  def verify_amount!(attempt, amount)29    value = amount.to_s30    raise InvalidNotification unless value.match?(/\A\d+(?:\.0+)?\z/) && BigDecimal(value) == BigDecimal(attempt.amount.to_s)31  end32end

app/services/reconcile_duitku_payment.rb

Cek API transactionStatus, cocokkan identitas/nominal, lock update dan lindungi paid dari callback terlambat.

Method yang dideklarasikan: initialize, call

Petunjuk pola kode
  • Transaction/lock: menjaga kesatuan perubahan dan mengatur request bersamaan; tidak menggantikan constraint DB.
  • Rescue: menangani exception yang disebut; lihat apakah hasil menjadi pesan, rollback atau retry.
Buka 46 baris kode
1require "bigdecimal"23class ReconcileDuitkuPayment4  class InvalidStatus < StandardError; end5  STATES = { "00" => "settlement", "01" => "pending", "02" => "cancel" }.freeze67  def initialize(attempt:, client: DuitkuClient.new(allow_disabled: true))8    @attempt = attempt9    @client = client10  end1112  def call(expected_reference: @attempt.transaction_id, manual: false)13    unless @attempt.provider == "duitku" && @attempt.merchant_code == @client.merchant_code && @attempt.gateway_environment == @client.environment14      raise InvalidStatus15    end16    @attempt.with_lock do17      return @attempt if @attempt.paid?18      if manual19        raise InvalidStatus if @attempt.status_checked_at && @attempt.status_checked_at > 30.seconds.ago20        @attempt.update!(status_checked_at: Time.current)21      end22    end2324    response = @client.transaction_status(@attempt.order_id)25    reference = response.fetch("reference")26    amount = response.fetch("amount").to_s27    unless response.fetch("merchantOrderId") == @attempt.order_id && reference.is_a?(String) && reference.present? &&28        (expected_reference.blank? || reference == expected_reference) &&29        amount.match?(/\A\d+(?:\.0+)?\z/) && BigDecimal(amount) == BigDecimal(@attempt.amount.to_s)30      raise InvalidStatus31    end32    state = STATES.fetch(response.fetch("statusCode"))33    @attempt.with_lock do34      return @attempt if @attempt.paid?35      raise InvalidStatus if @attempt.transaction_id.present? && @attempt.transaction_id != reference36      return @attempt if state == "pending" && @attempt.status != "pending"3738      attributes = { status: state, provider_status: response["statusCode"], transaction_id: reference, status_checked_at: Time.current }39      attributes[:settled_at] = Time.current if state == "settlement"40      @attempt.update!(attributes)41    end42    @attempt43  rescue KeyError, ArgumentError, ActiveRecord::RecordNotUnique44    raise InvalidStatus45  end46end

app/views/admin/users/_form.html.erb

Partial tampilan yang dipakai melalui render. Data berasal dari locals atau instance variable; jalur folder menunjukkan fitur pemakainya.

Petunjuk pola kode
  • I18n: t membaca key terjemahan; l memformat tanggal/waktu menurut locale.
  • Form: menghasilkan input dan token CSRF; model/url menentukan endpoint, permit menentukan data diterima.
Buka 22 baris kode
1<div class="card p-6 max-w-3xl">2  <% if @user.errors.any? %>3    <div role="alert" class="mb-5 rounded-xl bg-red-50 p-4 text-red-700">4      <ul class="list-disc pl-5"><% @user.errors.full_messages.each do |message| %><li><%= message %></li><% end %></ul>5    </div>6  <% end %>7  <%= form_with model: [:admin, @user], class: "space-y-5" do |form| %>8    <div><%= form.label :name, t("admin.users.name"), class: "block text-sm font-semibold mb-2" %><%= form.text_field :name, required: true, maxlength: 120, class: "input w-full", autocomplete: "name" %></div>9    <div><%= form.label :email, t("admin.users.email"), class: "block text-sm font-semibold mb-2" %><%= form.email_field :email, required: true, readonly: @user.persisted? && @user.provider.present?, class: "input w-full", autocomplete: "email" %></div>10    <div><%= form.label :phone, t("admin.user_management.phone"), class: "block text-sm font-semibold mb-2" %><%= form.telephone_field :phone, class: "input w-full", autocomplete: "tel" %></div>11    <% role_locked = @user.persisted? && (@user.admin? || @user == current_user || @user.businesses.exists? || @user.staff_member.present?) %>12    <div>13      <%= form.label :role, t("admin.users.role"), class: "block text-sm font-semibold mb-2" %>14      <%= form.select :role, User.roles.keys.map { |role| [t("admin.users.roles.#{role}"), role] }, {}, disabled: role_locked, class: "input w-full" %>15      <p class="text-xs text-ink-500 mt-2"><%= t(role_locked ? "admin.user_management.role_locked" : "admin.user_management.role_help") %></p>16    </div>17    <div><%= form.label :password, t("admin.user_management.password"), class: "block text-sm font-semibold mb-2" %><%= form.password_field :password, required: @user.new_record?, minlength: Devise.password_length.min, autocomplete: "new-password", class: "input w-full" %></div>18    <div><%= form.label :password_confirmation, t("admin.user_management.password_confirmation"), class: "block text-sm font-semibold mb-2" %><%= form.password_field :password_confirmation, required: @user.new_record?, autocomplete: "new-password", class: "input w-full" %></div>19    <p class="text-sm text-ink-500"><%= t("admin.user_management.password_help", minimum: Devise.password_length.min) %></p>20    <div class="flex gap-3"><%= form.submit t("admin.user_management.save"), class: "btn-primary btn-md" %><%= link_to t("admin.user_management.back"), admin_users_path, class: "btn-secondary btn-md" %></div>21  <% end %>22</div>

app/views/pwa/service-worker.js

Cache aset statis dan fallback offline; tidak menyimpan HTML akun/admin atau mengambil alih request mutasi.

Petunjuk pola kode
  • Query: kondisi/relasi membentuk SQL. Scope awal dan preload memengaruhi akses serta jumlah query.
Buka 53 baris kode
1const CACHE_PREFIX = "glowbook-static-"2const CACHE_NAME = `${CACHE_PREFIX}v3`3const FALLBACK_PAGE = "/offline.html"4const PRECACHE_URLS = [FALLBACK_PAGE, "/icon.png", "/icon-192.png", "/icon.svg"]56self.addEventListener("install", (event) => {7  event.waitUntil(8    caches.open(CACHE_NAME)9      .then((cache) => cache.addAll(PRECACHE_URLS))10      .then(() => self.skipWaiting())11  )12})1314self.addEventListener("activate", (event) => {15  event.waitUntil(16    caches.keys()17      .then((keys) => Promise.all(keys18        .filter((key) => key.startsWith(CACHE_PREFIX) && key !== CACHE_NAME)19        .map((key) => caches.delete(key))))20      .then(() => self.clients.claim())21  )22})2324self.addEventListener("fetch", (event) => {25  const request = event.request26  const url = new URL(request.url)2728  if (request.method !== "GET" || url.origin !== self.location.origin) return2930  if (request.mode === "navigate") {31    event.respondWith(fetch(request).catch(() => caches.match(FALLBACK_PAGE)))32    return33  }3435  const isStaticAsset = url.pathname.startsWith("/assets/") || ["/icon.png", "/icon-192.png", "/icon.svg"].includes(url.pathname)36  if (!isStaticAsset) return3738  event.respondWith(39    fetch(request).then((response) => {40      if (response.ok && response.type === "basic") {41        const copy = response.clone()42        return caches.open(CACHE_NAME)43          .then((cache) => cache.put(request, copy))44          .catch(() => undefined)45          .then(() => response)46      }47      return response48    }).catch(async () => {49      const cached = await caches.match(request)50      return cached || Response.error()51    })52  )53})

db/seeds.rb

Data demo development yang menghapus/mengisi ulang data; ditolak di production. Bukan bootstrap production.

Method yang dideklarasikan: fetch_image, attach, seed_user

Petunjuk pola kode
  • Query: kondisi/relasi membentuk SQL. Scope awal dan preload memengaruhi akses serta jumlah query.
  • Rescue: menangani exception yang disebut; lihat apakah hasil menjadi pesan, rollback atau retry.
Buka 321 baris kode
